description: Kernel-mystery probe (T-1778 round 3, erfc-probes): does the upper-tail path read z beyond fl(sqrt z)? Consecutive z doubles, so about half of neighbouring z share fl(sqrt(z)). If B = C everywhere the erfc kernel is entered with x = fl(sqrt z) and recomputes z = fl(x*x); if B differs between two z that share fl(sqrt z), the exp(-z) factor reads z directly and the x-rational is held fixed, which decouples the two factors. A = z, B = CHISQ.DIST.RT(2*z,1), C = ERFC.PRECISE(SQRT(z)), D = SQRT(z), E = GAMMA.DIST(z,0.5,1,TRUE).
